text: Seven students on Easter vacation [arrive at a small cabin in the snowy mountains near Øksfjord|trigger|travelling somewhere remote] and begin to drink and party. A passing hiker tells them how Nazi soldiers under Standartenführer Herzog [abused and tortured the local people|wrong|war and atrocity] for three years, looted the town's valuables and fled into the mountains, where all were assumed to have frozen. Then Erlend finds [an old wooden box of gold trinkets|images|clothes, jewellery and keepsakes], one of them pockets a coin, and [zombies in SS uniforms|threat|the dead that rise] close in across the snow.
